{{Article header|section=Mining|deck=Planetary resource-extraction activity introduced with the Rhino SRV.}}

'''Surface Mining''' is a planetary resource-extraction activity for ''Elite Dangerous'' associated with the [[Rhino]] [[Surface Recon Vehicles|Surface Recon Vehicle]]. Frontier describes it as a new way to acquire raw materials around geological sites on planetary surfaces and to extract more material from a planetary surface.<ref name="frontier-first-look">[https://www.elitedangerous.com/news/beneath-surface-your-first-look-rhino Beneath the Surface - Your First Look at the Rhino], Frontier Developments, 6 August 2026.</ref><ref name="frontier-august-dev-log">[https://www.elitedangerous.com/news/elite-dangerous-august-dev-log-2026 Elite Dangerous: August Dev Log 2026], Frontier Developments, 27 August 2026.</ref>

For the complete step-by-step procedure, see '''[[Surface Mining with the Rhino]]'''.

== Overview ==

Surface Mining expands SRV gameplay into a mining-focused ground loop. Frontier has described the Rhino as the vehicle built for this role, combining a larger cargo hold, built-in refinery, new scanning and extraction tools, and the torque needed to handle steeper inclines while carrying additional weight.<ref name="frontier-august-dev-log" />

The detailed extraction process is documented in [[Surface Mining with the Rhino]]. Frontier-confirmed mechanics should remain separated from first-day community-tested observations until the system has more live verification.

== Locating deposits ==

Frontier has announced that the Rhino has a built-in scanner that detects planetary mining deposits. The scanner marks mineral-rich patches on the planetary surface and on sensors so the crew can position the vehicle for extraction.<ref name="frontier-august-dev-log" />

== Resource depletion ==

Frontier has stated that locations and quantities of materials are generated across each planetary surface, and that collected deposits regenerate at a very slow rate. As a result, a single resource-rich location is not expected to regularly deliver a high output after it has been mined.<ref name="frontier-august-dev-log" />

== Related equipment ==

* [[Rhino]] — announced large SRV built for Surface Mining.
* [[Large Planetary Vehicle Hangar]] — required to deploy the Rhino from compatible ships.
* [[Planetary Mineral Scanner]] — Rhino equipment used to detect and mark planetary mining deposits.
